}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== {{See also|MediaTek reference design}}
===Feature=== *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7621A @880MHz :32KB I-cache and 32KB D-cache per core :256KB L2 cache (shared by dual-core) :Single processor operation configurable Gigabit Switch *Flash: 16MB (SPI NOR), RAM: 512MB (DDR3) *Suitable with 802.11ac MT7615, LTE, 3G mini PCIe cards *Mini PCIe, USB, Micro SD-XC, GPIOs, I2C, UART, GPIOs *5x Giga Ethernet ports with PoE MDI transceivers *Powerful Wi-Fi and IoT Gateway like LoRa, Sigfox *16 hardware queues to guarantee the min/max BW of each flow :HNAT/HQoS/Samba/VPN accelerators, support boot from flash :IPv4 routing, NAT, NAPT, SMP capable :IPv6 routing, DS-Lite, 6RD, 6to4, HW QoS *Seamlessly co-work with HW NAT engine :2Gbps wired speed HW Crypto Engine :Deliver 400~500 Mbps IPSec throughput Green *Intelligent Clock Scaling (exclusive)
==Links of Interest== ===Models=== *[[AsiaRF DP7621-002]] • Wi-Fi 5 Router Board *[[AsiaRF DP7621-IL1]] • Wi-Fi 5 Router Board *[[AsiaRF AW7615-NP1]] • AC1700 4T4R Mini PCIe Module :FCC ID: TKZAW7615NP1 (2021-11-09) • AC1700 WiFi 5 4T4R
